mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, increasing present value and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 9.5% signals a tightening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 9.5%, the S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS (both rising by >1% in the last month) fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90 indicates a manufacturing supply shock, squeezing corporate margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO falls below 90, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPI) signals inflationary pressure, leading to higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises, the S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts above 650 thousand units signals strong economic activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 650, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment and decline in unemployment indicates a robust labor market, driving consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE (both in the last month) fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a GDP growth slowdown (quarterly GDP growth below 1.5%), economic uncertainty rises, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 growth is below 1.5%, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
